crossRefs.note: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies…
Then David inquired of Yahweh yet again. Yahweh answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver…
shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out…
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve…
Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

translations.web: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
translations.bsb: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.
translations.kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
translations.asv: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment Scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
